correctness.rationale: The specified icosahedron has 12 vertices and 30 edges. Independently reconstructed its 323 admissible nonempty faces, f=(12,66,140,105), using induced maximum degree <=1. The stated successive-element matching has 151 pairs; reversing their edges in all 972 Hasse covers gives an acyclic digraph (topological order visits 323 vertices) and leaves one 0-cell and twenty 3-cells. Forman discrete Morse therefore yields an integral wedge of 20 S^3, not merely field Betti numbers. Independently enumerated all 120 adjacency automorphisms and Hopf simplex-signed traces for all elements; the rotation trace values (20,4,-1,0,0) and antipodal coset (10,2,1,0,0), together with the A5 character table, give (1+W4+2W5) antipodal-even and W5 antipodal-odd. Crosscheck_mod2.py was available but is not used as a substitute for integral homotopy.
residual_risks: Unindexed prior finite calculations of the same Ind_2(I) or automorphism action are not categorically excluded.
The symmetry decomposition is only over Q; no claim of integral lattice decomposition under antipodal involution.
